stories.sourceText: The illustrative grid route names Gate, Ridge, Marsh and Harbor, preserving supplied obstacles, goal and frontier without computing a shortest route. Gate is the open start node on the illustrative grid. Ridge is the open upper node on the illustrative grid. Marsh is the blocked lower node on the illustrative grid. Harbor is the open goal node on the illustrative grid. Gate connects to Ridge as an open link on the illustrative grid. Ridge connects to Harbor as an open link on the illustrative grid. Every open link on the illustrative grid has equal cost. The frontier contains Gate and Ridge in that order on the illustrative grid. The stated route runs Gate then Ridge then Harbor on the illustrative grid. The Gate to Harbor route is supplied only for the illustrative grid.
